Typefaces in print

Loaded with @font-face from local TrueType files, mixed with installed families.

Brand Serif is the body face, with bold, italic and bold italic (the last one synthesised or fallen back). Ligatures such as fi, fl and ffi appear in words like office, affluent and fluffier. Numbers 0123456789 and punctuation “quotes” — dashes – ellipsis… all come from the same file.

func Convert(ctx context.Context, in io.Reader) ([]byte, error) {
    doc, err := html.Parse(in)   // parse once
    if err != nil {
        return nil, fmt.Errorf("parse: %w", err)
    }
    return render(doc), nil
}
